_comment: SYNTHETIC test set (macOS `say`), not real calls. tts = what the voice reads (English terms spelled the way a ru/uk speaker says them, numbers as words); ref = reference transcript. keys = critical items checked separately: t=name|term|number|negation, any=accepted forms in the normalized hypothesis, not=forms that must NOT appear (for positive statements next to a negation trap).
